title: 提前了录影时间  (Moved Up the Taping Time)

segments.t: In the finale of Episode 1, Bu Xiaogu rushes to tell Wang Er that Chun Yuqiao moved the taping forward. As host Wen Simo welcomes real guest mentor Liu Fan on stage, Wang Er realises even he was kept completely in the dark. Listen first.
王尔老师，淳于总提前了录影时间！
他根本就没有告诉我。
女士们，先生们，接下来！
有请本场十二歌王的客座导师，刘凡先生！
也许从一开始，他就没打算过用我。
我就不该来当什么联合制作人。
在他眼里，我们都是工具。
只是他的一个棋子。
Now let's unpack the final reveal of Episode 1 line by line.
王尔老师，淳于总提前了录影时间！
'Teacher Wang Er, Director Chun Yu moved up the taping time!' Useful "tiqian", literally 'lift ahead', means move a schedule earlier than planned.
他根本就没有告诉我。
'He did not tell me at all.' Adding "genben" before "meiyou" intensifies a negative into 'not at all' or 'never in the slightest', and "gaosu" means 'tell'.
女士们，先生们，接下来！
'Ladies and gentlemen, up next!' Formal stage hosts open big moments with "nvshimen" and "xianshengmen" — 'ladies, gentlemen', adding "men" onto each title to address the whole crowd.
有请本场十二歌王的客座导师，刘凡先生！
'Please welcome tonight's Twelve Singers guest mentor, Mister Liu Fan!' Broadcast phrase "youqing" is the polished stage equivalent of 'please welcome to the stage', and "daoshi" means 'mentor'.
也许从一开始，他就没打算过用我。
'Maybe right from the beginning, he never intended to use me.' Soft "yexu" means 'perhaps', "cong yi kaishi" means 'right from the start', and "dasuan" means 'intend' or 'plan to'.
我就不该来当什么联合制作人。
'I never should have come to be some co-producer.' Regretful "bugai" shortens "bu yinggai" ('should not have'), while "dang" means serve as or work as a role.
在他眼里，我们都是工具。
'In his eyes, we are all tools.' Frame someone's viewpoint with "zai ta yanli", literally 'inside his eyes', and "gongju" means a tool or instrument.
只是他的一个棋子。

'Just one chess piece of his.' Calling yourself someone's "qizi", 'chess piece' or 'pawn', captures how completely Chun Yuqiao outmanoeuvred both the spy and his own team. Now listen to the closing scene of Episode 1 once more.
王尔老师，淳于总提前了录影时间！
他根本就没有告诉我。
女士们，先生们，接下来！
有请本场十二歌王的客座导师，刘凡先生！
也许从一开始，他就没打算过用我。
我就不该来当什么联合制作人。
在他眼里，我们都是工具。
只是他的一个棋子。
Chun Yuqiao outsmarted the leak and saved the show — leaving Xiaogu in awe and Wang Er quietly bitter. Congratulations on completing Episode 1 of Behind the Scenes! See you in Episode 2!
再见！
